concepts.name: A. The Growth Chart
concepts.world: A dashboard world: star counters, velocity graphs, the internet noticing.
concepts.shows: Open on the wordmark, cut straight to a sparkline of the star climb, close on a count-up.
concepts.money_shot: The star counter crossing 82k with a glow.
concepts.would_creator_repost: Flattering but generic. Every viral repo gets this exact video.
concepts.would_stranger_stop: A star chart alone does not explain what the tool DOES.
concepts.verdict: REJECTED. All scoreboard, no mechanics. Exactly the failure mode the routine's own substance layer exists to prevent.

concepts.name: B. Inside the Skill
concepts.world: A terminal and a system prompt, the actual machinery of the trick: type a command, watch the agent answer in fragments, see the architecture that makes it work.
concepts.shows: A 4-node diagram (install hook, system prompt, terse reply, fewer tokens), a real /caveman invocation with the real 'Me ready.' output, the honest README caveat that the skill can be net-negative, and the token receipt (1,180 down to 159) as the payoff before a single growth beat.
concepts.money_shot: An inverted flash beat naming the wenyan compression tier, the one detail that proves someone actually read the code.
concepts.would_creator_repost: Yes. It shows the trick working AND is honest about its limits, which is rarer and more flattering than pure hype.
concepts.would_stranger_stop: The terminal typing and the before/after numbers are a real demo, not an abstract claim.
concepts.verdict: SELECTED. Diegetic, product-first, satisfies the substance floor (product beats before the receipt), gives SCHEMATIC framework a natural architecture-diagram spine.

concepts.name: C. The Joke Taken Seriously
concepts.world: A mock-anthropological framing, caveman iconography, a wink at the silly premise.
concepts.shows: Skull emoji, cave-painting type treatment, a tongue-in-cheek tone throughout.
concepts.money_shot: A big comedic flourish on the word CAVEMAN.
concepts.would_creator_repost: Risky. Could read as mocking rather than admiring, and WRITING_RULES bars sycophancy in either direction.
concepts.would_stranger_stop: Maybe, but at the cost of looking like a meme account rather than a peer admiring real engineering.
concepts.verdict: REJECTED. Tone risk too high, and it does not naturally carry the substance floor's product beats.

wow_bets: Real terminal output (Me ready.) sourced straight from the docs, not invented
The README's own honesty about net-negative cases as an on-screen beat, which is rarer than pure hype
wenyan as the inverted-polarity surprise beat, a detail only a repo reader would know
Token receipt (1,180 to 159) landing as its own scene before the star count, so the mechanism outweighs the scoreboard
